sources.articleTitle: Watch: PM Modi extends Diwali wishes, will celebrate festival with soldiers
PM Modi conveys Deepavali greetings, says will celebrate the festival with soldiers

headline: Prime Minister Modi To Celebrate Deepavali With Military Personnel
seoTitle: PM Modi To Celebrate Diwali With Soldiers
metaDescription: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced his intention to celebrate the Deepavali festival alongside Indian military personnel at an undisclosed location.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared Deepavali greetings with the public.
The Prime Minister stated he intends to spend the festival with members of the military.
Official reports have not disclosed the specific military station or post for the event.
aiContextParagraph: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently extended festive greetings to the nation for Deepavali. In his public comments, the Prime Minister noted his established tradition of visiting military installations during the holidays to observe the festival alongside service members. While confirming that he will travel to a military location this year, the Prime Minister did not reveal the exact station or post where the visit will occur. Such visits have historically served as a means for the head of government to engage with troops stationed across various parts of the country. As of now, the specific itinerary and the venue for these planned interactions remain confidential according to the reports provided by major media outlets tracking the Prime Minister's public schedule during the holiday period.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to coverage by multiple major national news outlets reporting on the Prime Minister's holiday activities.
